parsed.name: CC-Light 控制器
parsed.description: CC-Light 是一台面向量子实验的数字控制与时序控制设备，可通过 SCPI 配置并执行控制存储器与 QISA 相关指令，用于协调触发、序列执行和实验时序管理，常见于超导量子比特测控实验。
parsed.description_en: The CC-Light is a digital control and timing instrument for quantum experiments. It can be configured over SCPI and execute control-store and QISA-related instructions to coordinate triggering, sequence execution, and experimental timing, commonly in superconducting qubit measurement and control setups.
